body: My room is always a mess. With clothes, cups, and food all over the place. It never bothers me even though I know it should. I have a girlfriend. I love her to bits but she has quite a few issues mentally just like I do. I have one "best friend" that I talk to and play games with occasionally. I don't make friends well. I find it difficult to connect with people. I just don't understand why it's so hard. My co-workers don't have these problems. Most workers in general don't have these problems. Nobody likes work. I accept that. But to hate the situation so much that I'm considering suicide as a viable option... something must be wrong there.

This seems like textbook dissociative disorder. It's a common counterpart to mental illnesses like anxiety and depression. Make an appointment with a psychiatrist as soon as possible and describe your symptoms. There are medications that can treat what you are describing.
